summary: Mbanza-Ngungu territory (Kongo-Central) straddles the Kinshasa-Matadi RN1 road and railway and contains Mbanza-Ngungu town (a major garrison town), Inkisi, the industrial towns of Lukala and Kwilu-Ngongo, and rural villages of the Boko-Kivulu, Gombe-Matadi, Kimpangu and Kwilu-Ngongo secteurs. It lies far from the eastern conflict zones and no armed group holds territory. Civilian areas are policed by the PNC under state administration, with a large FARDC presence in Mbanza-Ngungu's military camps (the 'Militaire' health area is assessed as FARDC-run). Security issues are crime and historically Bundu dia Kongo-related unrest, neither amounting to territorial control. Web research was unavailable for this run, so the assessment rests on default state presence.

zones.description: Mbanza-Ngungu town (territory headquarters on the Kinshasa-Matadi RN1/railway) and its civilian health-area neighbourhoods (Loma, Kumbi, Noki 2, Nsona Nkulu, Christ Roi, Ngungu, Athénée, Boko, Ville Haute, Kimaza)
zones.evidence: Largest town of the territory and a major garrison town; no armed group holds territory in Kongo-Central. Civilian neighbourhoods are policed by the PNC (commissariat, territorial administration), with a large FARDC presence from the military camps and schools. Urban crime and past Bundu dia Kongo unrest (2017-2020) did not displace state control. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines and Wikipedia blocked), so this rests on default state presence.

zones.description: Mbanza-Ngungu 'Militaire' health area (military camp: battalion lines, état-major, armoured/tank units, EFAT training school)
zones.evidence: The health area is a military camp (its sub-localities are named 1er/2ème Bataillon, Etat-Major, QG, Blindé, Tank, EFAT, Poudrière); order inside the camp is kept by the FARDC and military police rather than the PNC. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines and Wikipedia blocked), so this rests on default state presence.

zones.description: Inkisi (Kimpese-Inkisi agglomeration in Boko-Kivulu secteur) and its neighbourhoods (Cité Sele, Kintanu 1 and 2, De la Mission)
zones.evidence: Large town on the RN1/railway corridor; no reported armed-group activity. Order is kept by the PNC with state administration; FARDC elements transit/are present along the corridor. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines and Wikipedia blocked), so this rests on default state presence.

zones.description: Kwilu-Ngongo secteur towns: Lukala (Ntela, cement works), Kwilu-Ngongo/Moanda sugar town, Itaga/Makuati, Cité Gare, Kwilu, Finco
zones.evidence: Industrial towns (CILU cement at Lukala, sugar company at Kwilu-Ngongo) on the RN1 corridor; no armed-group territorial control reported. PNC posts with company security guards keep order. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines and Wikipedia blocked), so this rests on default state presence.

zones.description: Rural villages and small centres of Boko-Kivulu, Gombe-Matadi, Kimpangu, Kwilu-Ngongo and Mbanza-Ngungu secteurs
zones.evidence: No reported armed-group activity in rural Mbanza-Ngungu territory; state authority exercised through PNC posts, secteur administration and customary chiefs. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines and Wikipedia blocked), so this rests on default state presence.
